out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of hot water at the 3 compartment sink was observed at 106°F
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: exterior of 3 door fridge, exterior/ interior of fridge next to flattop grill, sides of fryers and side of refrigerator and flattop grill.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor under both areas of cooking are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: rice (130°F) and diced chicken (106°F) in hot holding unit in the front serving area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. RICE HOLDING UNIT 2pm. DICED CHICKEN REHEATED ON THE GRILL 187°F

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sour cream (50°F), pico de gallo (53°F) on a tray of ice.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. FOODS PUT OUT ON ICE AROUND 10:30am. MORE ICE ADDED TO PAN. DISCARD AT 2:30pm.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the handsink near the 2 door hot holding unit are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: EHS OBSERVED DICED COOKED CHICKEN IN PAN ON GRILL AT 125F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED DICED COOKED CHICKEN.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: EHS OBSERVED SLICED COOKED MEAT AT 44F in 2DR STACKED COOLER. EHS OBSERVED 2DR STACKED COOLER AT 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED SLICED COOKED MEAT.
